cell.description: Proves that a Chinese reading mark becomes a review item and its scheduler state survives a real Primer HTTP server process restart.

steps: Create an isolated temporary Primer data root and start a real Primer HTTP server, mounting the production reader and card route handlers, on an operating-system assigned loopback port.
POST a synthetic Chinese document and exact word mark through reader routes; query queue and review-session provenance.
Intake one provenance-bearing card through the production ledger API, then approve and enroll it through HTTP.
Grade the enrolled card Again, Hard, and Good under the fixed logical clock; assert monotonic due times and contiguous event versions.
Terminate the server process completely, retain the SQLite file, and start a new server process against the same isolated data root.
Query reader, enrolled-card, review-session, and review-event APIs from the restarted process; assert the provenance chain and exact due time survived.
Copy the checkpointed database, delete its scheduler row, restart a third real server, and require the declared persistence invariant to fail.

assertions: The document, exact mark paragraph/span/sentence, queue item, review event, and scheduler row are stored in the scenario SQLite database.
The restarted queue API returns the same mark paragraph/span/sentence provenance read directly from SQLite.
No state path escapes the isolated temporary workspace.
All lifecycle mutations and observations use real package APIs and the real loopback HTTP server; only deterministic fixture intake and negative-control mutation access SQLite directly.
The first server is terminated before the second server starts, the two process identifiers differ, and the actual restart count does not exceed maxRestarts.
The restarted server answers its readiness route before the persisted review session is queried, and all operations share the manifest's total timeout.

browser.reason: Skipped because @wirebabel/primer-daemon has no browser library or browser dependency in its runnable dependency set; the real HTTP process layer is the highest executable product boundary in this package.

assertions: Restarted HTTP responses and a post-restart SQLite join identify the exact document, mark, paragraph index, start/end span, source sentence, queue item, and graded review item consistently.
The persisted SQLite scheduler due timestamp and the post-restart HTTP scheduler due timestamp are byte-for-byte equal.
The negative control produces the declared scheduler-persistence invariant failure rather than a passing receipt.
oracle.invariant: After a full HTTP server process restart over the same SQLite database, the marked Chinese word remains scheduled with exactly the due timestamp committed before restart.

always: Terminate every server process started by the cell.
Close SQLite handles before removing the isolated temporary workspace.
Refuse cleanup paths that resolve outside the isolated temporary workspace.

negativeControl.mutation: Copy the checkpointed positive SQLite database, delete exactly the enrolled card's review_state row, then query a third real server process against that mutated database.
negativeControl.expectedInvariantFailure: The post-restart review session cannot return the exact scheduler due timestamp observed before restart because that scheduler state was not committed to SQLite.
